name: Esau
summary: The older twin brother of Jacob, a skillful hunter who sold his birthright for a bowl of stew. Jacob took his father's blessing, but years later Esau ran to meet him and they made peace.

key_moments.title: Born First
key_moments.description: Esau was born first, red and hairy, with his twin brother Jacob holding his heel. He grew up to be a skillful hunter, and his father Isaac loved him.

key_moments.title: Selling the Birthright
key_moments.description: Coming in faint from the field, Esau sold his birthright to Jacob for bread and lentil stew. So Esau treated his birthright as worthless.

key_moments.title: Loses His Father's Blessing
key_moments.description: When Esau brought his father the meal, he learned that Jacob had already taken the blessing. He cried out bitterly, and he planned to kill Jacob after their father died.

key_moments.title: Embraces Jacob
key_moments.description: When Jacob came home after many years, Esau ran to meet him, hugged him and kissed him, and the two of them wept. Then Esau went back to Seir.

key_moments.title: Moves to Mount Seir
key_moments.description: Esau and Jacob had too much livestock to live together, so Esau took his family to mount Seir. Esau is Edom, the father of the Edomites.
